title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 405) reviews: Diezani cleared in UK court

content.rendered:
Former Petroleum Minister Diezani Alison-Madueke has been cleared of all charges in a UK court after a legal battle that lasted more than a decade.

While some Nigerians see the verdict as proof she was wrongly accused, others argue it does not end broader conversations surrounding investigations, asset recoveries, and accountability in Nigeria’s oil sector during her years in office.
